snippet.title: Smalland 2: Lost Realms - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The Smallfolk are back, and the adventure ahead is bigger and better than ever. With an expanded world and brand-new gameplay features, you will explore, build, connect, and create in ways you never could in Smalland: Survive the Wilds! 

Wishlist Smalland 2: The Lost Realms now!
